top_signals.title: Stocks Slump as Wall Street Gets AI Wake-Up Call: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street got a reality check as a bruising rout in technology giants fueled concern the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has powered the equity bull market might be overblown.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
